methods.name: Plot-calibrated biomass change
methods.why: Fit biomass models using plot allometry and matched structural and spectral observations; propagate uncertainty in the difference.

methods.name: Stratified lidar and independent validation
methods.why: Sample predicted gains, losses and stable areas; use withheld plots, lidar height metrics and post-2023 disturbance records to assess bias and RMSE.

methods.name: Forest boundary masking
methods.why: Clip and area-weight estimates using an authoritative property boundary rather than the geocoder bounding box.

next_steps: Obtain Yale Forests boundary, georeferenced plot inventories and harvest records.
Verify local 2016 point cloud coverage, acquisition dates and availability of 2024 Yale-Myers lidar.
Request YCGS flight and coordinate field plot measurements.
